question: Could you analyze the relationship between each complaint type and daily temperature in New York City, specifically using temperature data from LaGuardia (STN=725030) and JFK (STN=744860) airports for the 10 years starting in 2008, and then determine, for each complaint type that has more than 5000 total occurrences and shows a strong correlation (absolute value > 0.5) with temperature, the total number of complaints, the total number of days with valid temperature records, and the Pearson correlation coefficients (rounded to four decimals) between temperature and both the daily complaint count as well as the daily percentage of total complaints, excluding any days with missing or invalid temperature data (such as 9999.9)?

WITH daily_temp AS (
  SELECT 
    CAST(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS DATE) as date,
    AVG(temp) as avg_temp
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2008`
  WHERE stn IN ('725030', '744860') AND temp != 9999.9
  GROUP BY date
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    CAST(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS DATE) as date,
    AVG(temp) as avg_temp
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2009`
  WHERE stn IN ('725030', '744860') AND temp != 9999.9
  GROUP BY date
  UNION ALL
  SELECT

    AVG(temp) as avg_temp
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2010`
  WHERE stn IN ('725030', '744860') AND temp != 9999.9
  GROUP BY date
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    CAST(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS DATE) as date,
    AVG(temp) as avg_temp
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2011`
  WHERE stn IN ('725030', '744860') AND temp != 9999.9
  GROUP BY date
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    CAST(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS DATE) as date,
    AVG(temp) as avg_temp
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2012`
  WHERE stn IN ('725030', '744860') AND temp != 9999.9
  GROUP BY date
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    CAST(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS DATE) as date,
    AVG(temp) as avg_temp
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2013`
  WHERE stn IN ('725030', '744860') AND temp != 9999.9
  GROUP BY date
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    CAST(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS DATE) as date,
    AVG(temp) as avg_temp
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2014`
  WHERE stn IN ('725030', '744860') AND temp != 9999.9
  GROUP BY date
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    CAST(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS DATE) as date,
    AVG(temp) as avg_temp
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2015`
  WHERE stn IN ('725030', '744860') AND temp != 9999.9
  GROUP BY date
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    CAST(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS DATE) as date,
    AVG(temp) as avg_temp
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2016`
  WHERE stn IN ('725030', '744860') AND temp != 9999.9
  GROUP BY date
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    CAST(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS DATE) as date,
    AVG(temp) as avg_temp
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2017`
  WHERE stn IN ('725030', '744860') AND temp != 9999.9
  GROUP BY date
),
complaint_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    CAST(created_date AS DATE) as date,
    complaint_type,
    COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.311_service_requests`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM created_date) BETWEEN 2008 AND 2017
  GROUP BY date, complaint_type
),
total_by_date AS (
  SELECT date, SUM(cnt) as total_cnt
  FROM complaint_counts
  GROUP BY date
),
joined AS (
  SELECT 
    dt.date,
    dt.avg_temp,
    cc.complaint_type,
    cc.cnt as daily_complaints,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(cc.cnt, tb.total_cnt) * 100 as pct_total
  FROM daily_temp dt
  JOIN complaint_counts cc ON dt.date = cc.date
  JOIN total_by_date tb ON dt.date = tb.date
),
corr_calc AS (
  SELECT 
    j.complaint_type,
    COUNT(*) as num_days,
    (COUNT(*) * SUM(j.avg_temp * j.daily_complaints) - SUM(j.avg_temp) * SUM(j.daily_complaints)) 
      / NULLIF(SQRT((COUNT(*) * SUM(j.avg_temp * j.avg_temp) - SUM(j.avg_temp) * SUM(j.avg_temp))
        * (COUNT(*) * SUM(j.daily_complaints * j.daily_complaints) - SUM(j.daily_complaints) * SUM(j.daily_complaints))), 0) as corr_temp_complaints,
    (COUNT(*) * SUM(j.avg_temp * j.pct_total) - SUM(j.avg_temp) * SUM(j.pct_total))
      / NULLIF(SQRT((COUNT(*) * SUM(j.avg_temp * j.avg_temp) - SUM(j.avg_temp) * SUM(j.avg_temp))
        * (COUNT(*) * SUM(j.pct_total * j.pct_total) - SUM(j.pct_total) * SUM(j.pct_total))), 0) as corr_temp_pct
  FROM joined j
  GROUP BY j.complaint_type
),
complaint_totals_all AS (
  SELECT complaint_type, COUNT(*) as total_complaints
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.311_service_requests`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM created_date) BETWEEN 2008 AND 2017
  GROUP BY complaint_type
)
SELECT 
  cc.complaint_type,
  ct.total_complaints,
  cc.num_days,
  ROUND(cc.corr_temp_complaints, 4) as corr_temp_complaints,
  ROUND(cc.corr_temp_pct, 4) as corr_temp_pct
FROM corr_calc cc
JOIN complaint_totals_all ct ON cc.complaint_type = ct.complaint_type
WHERE ct.total_complaints > 5000
  AND (ABS(cc.corr_temp_complaints) > 0.5 OR ABS(cc.corr_temp_pct) > 0.5)
ORDER BY cc.complaint_type
